notes.title: Thanksgiving day radar update
notes.notes:
Happy thanksgiving day, everyone!
The new Wayfarer branch update brings a radar built directly on your wrist.
What will be shown:
Nearby -> Structures, identified vehicles, identified enemies/allies/neutrals, beacons, and identified resources

Far away (perimeter of the radar) -> Only structures and identified allies, and beacons.

Extra: blips that are further away from the center of the radar will appear scaled down

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306372/252022717b1d27db57d89739caa7368dc28c6b64.png[/img]


How it works:
-Take a closer look at it  (less than 15 cm from your eyes) to expand it and populate it with blips of the nearby locations.
-Move your hand away further than 30 cm to close it again (it will remain as a tiny spherical compass on your wrist) 

If you want it to disappear easier, you can turn your wrist to make the center of the radar sphere be further away from you, that will allow you to close it without having to move your arms around as much.

THIS FEATURE IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT
Future versions will include better blips, a 2D blip base at the horizontal level of the radar, and a line connecting the base of the blip and the blip itself. This way any blips that are higher or lower than the player will have lines to better represent their position relative to you.


Want to access a more detailed changelog? Check our discord server: https://discord.gg/2qQBg2ZDuv

notes.title: Explosive barrels, gas tanks, and safe zone force fields!
notes.notes:
-Added gas tanks and barrels, which are explosive and can be shot at. When they are hit, a hole is produced in them, causing them to leak and be set on fire. This jet of fire creates thrust and slowly consumes the fuel inside of them. If they are shot with a very powerful bullet or their fuel reaches zero, they explode, launching shrapnel everywhere.

 -Gas tanks have a valve which upon being shot, is detached creating a huge jet that produces a lot of thrust and causes the gas tank to explode shortly after

 -Added safe zones, which stop bullets from entering from the outside, and it makes bullets fired inside of it become (almost) inert and twist in the air. The flight pattern of each bullet does change with the weight, drag, and normal velocity of the projectile being shot, but all of them receive an extreme amount of spin in random directions, making most of them fly in a corkscrew trajectory to the sides, up or down in an inpredictable way. 

 -Fixed an issue with UI elements of the ammo selector that made the laser not appear when aiming between the buttons, and also re-enabled the functionality of the side buttons (that stopped working while upgrading the project)

 -Changed the way collisions between small objects and the character rig happen (Now these objects will collide with your body and locosphere)
 -Added a default dead zone of 0.05 to all inputs except WMR and Oculus which have a dead zone of 0.15

notes.title: 0.09.01 is live
notes.notes:
Attention to Steam page fanatics, you can check the previous changelogs in the official discord server
https://discord.com/invite/warlab


Change-log
🛠️  -Updated project to Unity 2021.3.39f1 LTS
🐎 -A lot of internal refactoring and small optimizations as well as future proofing.
✨ -Added LIDAR scanners to help find out the colliders of objects. They are completely configurable and come in a line scan mode and a cone scan mode, when the laser hits a dynamic object, the particle generated will last just a few seconds, but if you hit a static object, it will last for minutes (you can toggle among several delays to match your needs) 

✨ -Added a property "destroy on contact" and "destroy on penetration" to projectiles that will make them vanish if they contact or penetrate a surface (contact means any contact with a surface, penetration requires that the projectile does not ricochet off the surface)
✨ -Added a property "destroy projectiles on contact" and "destroy projectiles on penetration" to ballistic materials (same as with the projectiles, but now the material dictates if the projectile that has collided with it is destroyed or not)

(Note that projectiles will still be stopped by losing energy while penetrating a material, these two features will be applied to special kinds of projectiles, such as darts that can inject substances on targets (poison, tranquilizer, etc), explosive ammunition, or in the colliders of holographic shields that will instantly stop bullets and high tier armor) 

✨ -Per projectile gravity (now some projectiles can experience a greater or lesser drop depending on their type)


🛠️  - Hands no longer collide with each other to ease handing of small objects and avoid unnecessary haptics when collisions happen.
🛠️  - Removed most of the colliders associated with player's fingers to make it easier to grab, distance grab, drop, and throw items, while making it possible to poke things with your index finger, such as buttons or objects. 

🐛  -Removed some console logs (like lumberjacking damage to trees)

notes.title: Designing, prototyping, testing, fixing, polishing, release, and upgrade
notes.notes:
Making a videogame is not easy, making a good videogame is even harder.

Everything from the general concept of the game to the most subtle detail of the lore is decided and executed using the same technique: think three times, measure twice, do once. Then, redo, improve, extend and expand. 

With all the help of quality testing and community feedback since the beginning of the project, the development of the game is not only faster but produces a better result. 

Once the foundation is well set and reinforced by the confidence of the analysis of user feedback from similar games, the playtest will open the main source to quantity feedback, from all kinds of users: hardcore all-nighters, casuals, noobies, experts, rookies, the kid that punches the TV, that guy that loses balance easily, the squeaker screaming over there, the grandpa that doesn't believe in technology, those who feel ill easily, the sweaty try-hards, and of course, you. 

We want as many people as possible to enjoy the game, and for that, we need feedback from as many different people as possible. The playtest will come once the first few components are ready, you will soon be able to try it out and explain what you like, and what you don't.


At this point in time, testers have been divided into groups, each of them has a purpose and together they will help to manage the content that is added to the game through the alphas, early access, release, and late content updates.

Alpha team -> evaluating the new features being added before anyone else, testing the implementation of new elements (they must be easy to understand with little context and comfortable to use and live with)
Beta team -> Looking for bugs, exploits, unintended behavior, erratic behavior, possible enhancements, alternatives, and other quality of life improvements. 
Steam playtest -> Feedback, looking for changes and new additions, and commenting on everything as if they were part of teams Alpha and Beta, with their own perspective.


Some of you have asked who will be able to join the playtest, and the answer is simple: everyone.
Once the playtest is made public, everyone that has asked to participate in it will be granted access to it, and from there on, more people will be allowed to join as the community expands.

During the early access, those users that invite friends to try out the game will be rewarded with cosmetics and (in some cases) free expansions of the game. Stay tuned for more information regarding this, especially once the discord is made public to the playtest users. 

Thanks for all the support and the effort from the community.
